blocks.text: Jeremiah 31 contains 40 verses. It opens with: At that time, saith Jehovah, will I be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be my people. It concludes with: And the whole valley of the dead bodies and of the ashes, and all the fields unto the brook Kidron, unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east, shall be holy unto Jehovah; it shall not be plucked up, nor thrown down any more for ever.
